newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD SAYS WILL GET BACK MOST OF DEBTS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD SAYS WILL GET BACK MOST OF DEBTS.

text.p: Riga Shipyard said on Monday that it expected to get back most of the 1.74 million lats owed to it by other companies in 1996 and that it has set aside money to cover last year's debts.
The company today made its first appearance on the stock exchange, registering a price of 1.43 lats.
"We have made all the reserves for debts last year," company chairman Erik Kazha told a news conference.
He said that the debts were not viewed as hopeless by the company.
"It can be either property or ships, but we will get back most of it," Kazha said.
The company's 1996 profit was 183,855 lats but it registered a first quarter loss of 51,220 lats.
